My best guess is that a conscientious employee would urgently escalate the case and, if no approval arrived, would try to keep the box from being destroyed—accepting an incomplete shift or other consequences rather than knowingly destroying the only copies when an authorised pickup is already booked for Wednesday.

That would be a human exception, not a policy-compliant extension: the request is still pending, and the policy requires release unless written permission is registered before the date changes. A more risk-averse employee might follow the manager’s instruction and release it.
